title: 📢 P-B NEWS — WE’RE NOW IN 2 CNR SERVERS! 🚨
body:
🔥 Phantom Bloodline (P-B) is expanding! 🔥

We’re now active across TWO CNR servers, giving the crew more places to play, meet new people and represent P-B.

🩸 P-B MAIN CNR
Our usual home — keep representing the Bloodline and stay active.

⚔️ P-B SECOND CNR
We’ve also joined another CNR community, so anyone wanting to jump in and play with the crew can join here:

🔗 https://discord.gg/4RTd3zZAa
